Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Dr. Kartikey Hari Gupta, learned 
counsel for petitioner in CLCON/136/ 
2025.
2. Mr. Gulshan Pandey, learned counsel 
for petitioners in CLCON/193/2021.
3. Mr. J.S. Bisht, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.
4. State has lost from all the forums 
and the order passed by the Writ Court 
dated 07.01.2021 has been affirmed.
5. Learned State Counsel on 
06.05.2026 made a statement before 
Coordinate Bench of this Court that the 
matter is under consideration at the 
highest level and the order passed by 
Writ Court would be complied with. He 
prayed for and was granted 01 month’s 
time and the matter was fixed for today  i.e. 01.07.2026 after fresh cases.
6. It is quite surprising that even 
today, no compliance of the said order 
has been made by respondents￾contemnors.
7. Learned State Counsel made a 
statement again saying that the matter 
is still under consideration at the highest 
level and would be resolved very soon. 
8. But, said statement, in the opinion 
of this Court, is not sufficient. This Court 
is not concerned as to what is happening 
in the State Government at different 
levels, the only concern of this Court is, 
in compliance of the order passed by 
Writ Court.
9. This Court is expecting that after 
losing from all the forums, the order 
passed by Writ Court would be complied
with by them. Otherwise, the Court have 
no option, but to frame charges against 
the respondents-contemnors on next 
date fixed.
10. Put up on 06.07.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 01.07.2026
PN
